title: Fleet profile curator and cost-signal consolidation for right-sizing recommendations
creator: Ava Patel
description: Problem: Customers with Dedicated fleets struggle to balance throughput guarantees and unit cost. Existing reports show utilization but fail to combine SLO-aware tail latency, burst seasonality, and tenant packing economics into a single prescriptive action. Goal: Build a Fleet Profile Curator that consolidates cost signals (token cost, GPU slot-hours), performance signals (P50/P95/P99 latency, queue depth), and seasonality priors to produce ranked right-sizing recommendations and autoscale policy templates per pool and per-tenant.
proposed_solution: 1) Ingest multi-source signals: kube metrics, runtime telemetry (per-route token rates, KV cache hit rates), and billing exports. 2) Synthesize a compact fleet profile per pool: steady-state throughput, burst percentile distribution, tail-latency risk score, and on-call SLA class. 3) Run a what-if optimizer: simulate shrink/grow scenarios with synthetic load shading (shadow runs) to estimate SLO violation probability and cost delta. 4) Produce ranked recommendations: 'Shrink by X slots', 'Add burst capacity Y', and provide autoscale policy templates (min/max/scale-step/cooldown) with expected cost savings and risk. 5) Surface in Console + API (recommendation object) with links to a one-click apply workflow that stages changes in a canary pool first.
acceptance_criteria: Fleet Profile records exist for 90% of dedicated pools and include utilization, P99 latency, KV cache hit rate, and billing signal
What-if planner can simulate a 30% sustained traffic drop and report predicted cost delta and SLO risk within 10% of observed shadow-run error
Recommendations UI lists top-3 actions per pool with estimated monthly savings and a risk score
Generated autoscale policy templates pass unit tests and can be applied via the Console to a canary pool
APIs return recommendation objects with schema v1 and documentation link
rollout_plan: Phase 1: Data ingest and offline profile curator (read-only) - 2 weeks
Phase 2: What-if simulator + shadow-run harness against dev clusters - 2 weeks
Phase 3: Recommendation engine + API + Console surface behind feature flag - 1 week
Phase 4: Canary apply loop and safety hooks (circuit-breakers) - 1 week
Phase 5: Gradual enablement for customers with opt-in and audit logging - 2 weeks
progress_updates: 2026-03-10: Kickoff meeting with PM and Console UX. Agreed on initial schema for Fleet Profile (utilization, latency percentiles, billing signals).

2026-03-11: PoC ingestion pipeline implemented to pull billing CSVs and runtime telemetry into the analytics namespace. Initial ETL scripts committed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/fleet-curator/pull/12
2026-03-12: Decided to model seasonality using a hybrid: weekly Fourier basis + event tags (deployments/marketing). Trade-off: simpler model reduces false positives for short spikes.
2026-03-13: Simulated shrink scenarios on two staging pools. Observed P99 increase under sustained 50% slot reduction. Added safety floor of min_slots that preserves SLOs.
2026-03-14: UX review feedback: show 'confidence band' and expected rollback plan alongside savings estimate. Console mock updated: https://docs.google.com/drawings/example
decisions: Use conservative default confidence to prioritize availability over cost for P1 customers
Shadow-run synthetic load will run for 10 minutes at target scale factors to estimate transient queueing effects
Recommendation engine will provide both automated templates and human-in-the-loop suggestions; automated apply is behind an enterprise-only feature flag
risks: Underestimating tail-latency effects when co-locating additional tenants could cause SLO breaches
Billing signal lag could make short-term recommendations inaccurate; mitigation: use recent-window extrapolation and label low-confidence recommendations
Edge cases for heterogeneous models in the same pool (different sequence lengths/kv usage) complicate packing heuristics
qa_tests: Unit: profile aggregation correctness with synthetic telemetry fixtures
Integration: what-if simulator accuracy against shadow-run baseline
E2E: Console apply workflow to canary pool and automated rollback on SLO breach
Load: run synthetic seasonal pattern replay and verify recommendation stability
